notification.primary.subject: Registration required for {{title}}
notification.primary.body:
You have been assigned to {{title}}. External registration is required.

Deadline: {{deadline}} ({{timezone}})
Registration link: {{url}}

Once you have registered, mark it in Timeline.
notification.reminder.subject: Reminder: registration for {{title}}
notification.reminder.body:
A reminder about registration for {{title}}.

Deadline: {{deadline}} ({{timezone}})
Registration link: {{url}}

Once you have registered, mark it in Timeline to stop the reminders.
notification.overdue.subject: The registration deadline for {{title}} has passed
email.verification.subject: Confirm your address in Timeline
email.verification.heading: Confirm your address
email.verification.intro: Confirm your email address so Timeline can send you reminders about event registration.
email.verification.aside: If you did not create a Timeline account, ignore this message — nothing will happen.
email.password_reset.subject: Account recovery in Timeline
email.password_reset.heading: Set a new password
email.password_reset.intro: Someone asked to recover access to your Timeline account. Set a new password to continue.
email.password_reset.aside: Once the password changes, every active session is signed out. If you did not request recovery, ignore this message — the password stays as it is.
email.email_change.subject: Confirm your new address in Timeline
email.email_change.heading: Confirm your new address
email.email_change.intro: Confirm that this address belongs to you so Timeline can move your account to it.
email.email_change.aside: Until you confirm, you sign in with the previous address. If you did not ask to change it, ignore this message.
email.invite.subject: You are invited to Timeline
email.invite.heading: You are invited to Timeline
email.invite.intro: Timeline keeps track of the events you take part in: who is assigned where, when registration closes, and what is still waiting for you. Create an account to see your own.
email.invite.aside: The invitation works for this address only. If it reached you by mistake, ignore this message.
email.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into the address bar:
email.footer.automatic: This message was sent automatically. There is nobody to reply to.
digest.weekly.subject: What is on this week in Timeline
notification.telegram.linked: Account linked. Notifications from Timeline will arrive here.
notification.telegram.stale: That link has expired. Open Timeline, go to your profile and start the Telegram link again.
notification.telegram.hint: This bot delivers Timeline notifications. To connect it, open your profile on Timeline and follow the Telegram link there.
